extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: sea kayak (touring kayak), hull approx. 5.2 x 0.6 x 0.36 m (L x W x H), double paddle 2.2 m (overall width with paddle 2.2 m, height 0.42 m)
extras.notes: bow faces -Y; sits on its keel at z = 0, add your own water (waterline at 7.5 cm: blue boot stripe above the coral bottom); kayak_paddle is a separate object with origin in the middle of the shaft, resting across the deck in front of the cockpit; open cockpit with seat; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
